- Does the Sa2VA-4b in table 2 and table4/6 not the same model (the one from table 2 does not involve co-training and the the one from table 4/6 involves co-training)? but from my understanding, they should both be the finalized model?

- If they are the same Sa2VA-4b model, do it perform different benchmarks for table2 and table 4/6?
- Are these numbers are just fluctuations from different runs?

Thanks a lot for your help and clarification!
